answer: A freshness pulse gates every action: each identity must show a proof-of-liveness signed within 5 minutes or its thread of votes freezes. Keeping a fake farm alive means every puppet polls a clock and signs a fresh pulse before each attestation, so 1000 fakes need 1000 synchronized keepalives, and they fail the moment one clock drifts. The ledger stamps each opal-bound pulse with source entropy; an auditor replays the schedule and spots clocks that only ever beat in unison. Honest agents sign once per session; a farm signs a thousand times per minute, and that asymmetry is the deterrent.
